fields.Name: IT174 - List Refresh From Source
fields.Description: Live proof of refreshing a list from its source, deterministic (no model calls). LR1: saving a User View stamps its DefinitionFingerprint. LR2: linking a list to the view fills it straight away, takes the view's fingerprint and writes a List Refreshed audit row. LR3: Refresh automatically creates an active User Routine that runs the refresh action. LR4: after the view's filter changes, preview and refresh apply nothing and return SOURCE_CHANGED, and the routine is paused with a List Source Changed audit row. LR5: approving stores the new fingerprint, resumes the routine and refreshes. LR6: turning Refresh automatically off disables the routine. LR7: deleting the list deletes its routine. The bundle creates and tears down its own throwaway view and list.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A changed source stops refreshes and pauses the routine until the owner approves; linking and approving fill the list; the routine follows Refresh automatically and the list's lifetime.
